scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix vendor/everything/src/teamchat && npm ci --prefix vendor/everything/src/meetings
scripts.build:teamchat: npm run build:worker --prefix vendor/everything/src/teamchat && cd vendor/everything/src/teamchat && npx vite build --base ./ --outDir ../../../../apps/shell/public/teamchat --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:vendored: npm run build:teamchat && npm run build:meetings
scripts.dev: npm run build:vendored && npm run dev -w @collab/shell
scripts.build: npm run build:vendored && npm run build -w @collab/shell
